_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Navigate to /new. Type "screenshot image" into the message input (data-testid "message-input") and click the send button (data-testid "send-button"). Wait (up to 60 seconds) for an element to appear inside an agent message (selector ".message-agent img"). That image's src attribute should start with "/api/message/" and contain "/file?path=" and contain "shelley-screenshots". The image should actually load: its naturalWidth (read via eval on the img element) should be greater than 0.
